stem: Reena needs the additive inverse of $+12$.

part_answers.answer: The additive inverse is the opposite-sign integer at the same distance from zero; $+12$ and $-12$ cancel to $0$.

teacher.key_rationale: Additive inverse of +12 is -12 because they cancel to 0. B stops at the term "opposite integer". C grabs the printed digits without the sign change.
